title: Underived continuous functions compute derived internal functions of profinite parameters
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology, and a finite intermediate field $E$. For $F=E$ or $\Omega$ put $A_F(S)=C(S,F)$ with all continuous functions [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Use the small coherent profinite site in [def-weil-size-convention], its ordinary internal $A_F$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and ordinary derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. For a profinite set $P$ in these universes, let $A_F[P]$ be the free internal $A_F$-module on $\underline P(S)=C(S,P)$; this is the left adjoint to forgetting modules to condensed sets. Let $\mathcal C_F(P)$ be the internal module whose sections on $S$ are $C(S\times P,F)$, with $A_F(S)$ acting through the $S$-coordinate. Evaluation identifies it with $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_{A_F}(A_F[P],A_F)$, where internal module Hom is the right adjoint of internal tensor. Derive this Hom in its second variable by nonnegative injective resolutions. The canonical resolution comparison is an isomorphism
$$\mathcal C_F(P)[0]\longrightarrow R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_{A_F}(A_F[P],A_F[0])$$
in $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{A_F})$. It is natural contravariantly in every continuous map of profinite parameter sets and its degree-zero map is the evaluation identification just specified. No completeness hypothesis on $\Omega$, completion of $F$, or restriction to locally constant functions is imposed.
